transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Electrical Impedance Myography: Natural History Studies inNeuromuscular Disorders and Healthy Volunteers". I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 47 years old, so I am definitely 18 or older.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you currently in good health without any known neuromuscular disorders or other significant medical conditions?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have metastatic cervical carcinoma and have had multiple recurrences and treatments. I also have mild neuropathy in my fingertips and toes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you willing to follow all the study procedures and available for the entire duration of this study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the duration of this study, so I can't say if I'm available for the entire time. I am willing to follow procedures, but I need to know how long it lasts.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Could you let me know the expected duration of this study so I can confirm if you'll be available for the entire time?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the expected duration of this study, so I can't confirm if I'll be available for the entire time.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you willing to sign a written informed consent document to participate in this study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the details of this study yet, so I can't confirm if I'm willing to sign a consent form. I need to understand what the trial involves first.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To clarify, if you were to learn the study details, would you be willing to sign a document agreeing to participate?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the details of this study yet, so I can't confirm if I'm willing to sign a consent form. I need to understand what the trial involves first.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The trial asks about this: “The participant is a healthy child, male or female, age 7-18”. Does this describe you?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I am a 47-year-old woman, not a child.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Would you be willing to follow all the study procedures and be available for the entire duration of the trial if you were to participate?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the duration of this study, so I can't confirm if I'll be available for the entire time. I am willing to follow procedures, but I need to know how long it lasts.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Once you know the study duration, would you be available to participate for that entire time?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the duration of this study, so I can't confirm if I'll be available for the entire time.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been told by a doctor that you might have motor neuron disease, or have you had symptoms like muscle weakness or twitching that led to such a suspicion?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have never been told I might have motor neuron disease. I do have mild neuropathy in my fingertips and toes, but that is different.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you 2 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 47 years old, so I am definitely 2 years of age or older.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you able to read and sign a written informed consent document for this study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am able to read and sign the document. I am a 47-year-old woman managing my own care.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently an employee of the NIH, the EMG Section, the OCD, or the NINDS?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I am not an employee of the NIH, the EMG Section, the OCD, or the NINDS.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have any medical conditions, such as diabetes, kidney disease, or liver disease, that require medication affecting the study's physiological measures?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have diabetes or kidney disease, but I do have significant hepatic disease from my cancer progression.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Does your liver disease require any medications that might affect the physiological measures being tested in this study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if my liver disease requires any specific medications that would affect this study. I know I have significant hepatic disease, but I don't have details on the medications for it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To help us understand your situation better, are you currently taking any medications for your liver disease or any other medical conditions?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I am taking specific medications for my liver disease. I have had various cancer treatments like carbo/taxol/pembro and tisotumab vedotin, but I don't have details on current liver-specific meds.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To clarify, are you currently taking any prescription medications, supplements, or injections for your liver disease or cancer right now?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I am currently taking any specific prescription medications, supplements, or injections for my liver disease or cancer right now. I have had various treatments in the past, but I don't have details on my current medication list.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
